description: This dataset shows the locations of mobile phone installations and radio masts requiring approval in the city of Krefeld, Germany. Contents: point features, each carrying the site certificate number (Standortbescheinigungsnummer) issued by the Bundesnetzagentur; radio installations above certain transmit power limits must meet the personal-protection requirements for electromagnetic fields under the BEMFV. The city holds further internal attributes such as installation status (planned, operating) and site type (mast, rooftop), but the public data include only the certificate number. Producer: the City of Krefeld, distributed through Open.NRW with a WFS service run by KRZN geoservices. Coverage: the city of Krefeld. Access: an OGC Web Feature Service (GetCapabilities and GetFeature) usable from GIS software, with documentation linked to the Bundesnetzagentur EMF pages. Licence and cost: Data Licence Germany Zero 2.0, free without conditions. Caveats: only masts needing certification are included, with no operator, technology or height, and the certificate number must be joined to the Bundesnetzagentur database for details. Simulation uses: mast positions support local exposure and resilience analysis of mobile sites and joins to national site data. Related record: the Bundesnetzagentur EMF radio sites database (data-bnetza-emf-datenbank-radio-sites).
